Subject: Clarification regarding your request

Dear [Name],

I hope this message finds you well.

I am writing to seek clarification on a few points in your recent email to ensure I provide exactly what you need.

First, regarding the instruction to "name the shape with three sides," could you please clarify the context or purpose of this request? I want to make sure I understand how this relates to the documents or the discussion.

Second, you mentioned forwarding documents from our previous discussion. Could you please specify which particular documents or topics from that discussion you are referring to? This will help me locate and send the correct files.

Finally, regarding your request for my thoughts on how to proceed, could you please elaborate on which specific aspects or next steps you would like me to focus on? This will allow me to provide more targeted and useful input.

Thank you for your time, and I look forward to your clarification.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
